We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: Yang, operating a pharmacy's Chinese medicine department, without drug production license, purchased raw Chinese medicinal pieces, repackaged them into packaging, labeled, and sold. This is illegal drug manufacturing / processing without license. Likely crimes: illegal manufacturing of medicinal products (非法生产、非法经营药品). In Chinese criminal law, there is offense of "非法生产、销售假药" or "非法生产、销售药品" (illegal production of medicines). Also "非法经营药品" (illegal drug business). The facts: no drug production license, repackaging and labeling, selling. That is illegal manufacturing (加工) and illegal business. So charge: "非法生产、销售药品" or "非法经营药品". In examples, they used "虚开增值税专用发票" etc. For drug offenses, typical label: "非法生产、销售假药" if counterfeit, but here not counterfeit, just unlicensed production. So "非法生产、销售药品" (illegal production and sale of medicines). Also possibly "非法经营药品" as separate. Usually Chinese law: Article 141 of Criminal Law: illegal production, sale of medical devices, etc. Actually article 141: "非法生产、销售假药" (illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs). Article 140: "非法生产、销售药品" (illegal production and sale of medicines). Also article 144: "非法经营药品" (illegal operation of drug business). The facts: He repackaged and sold, without license. That is illegal manufacturing (processing) and illegal business. Could be charged with "非法生产、销售药品" (illegal production and sale of medicines). Might also include "非法经营药品" but usually one charge covers both. In examples they sometimes list multiple charges separated by semicolon. Here likely single charge: "非法生产、销售药品". Let's answer that.
